children: Phreesia, Inc. reported results for 2026 with total revenues of $129.46M, up from $117.26M a year earlier, and diluted EPS of $0.03 versus $0.01 in the prior-year quarter; net income was $1.92M compared with $654K in the year-ago period.
¹ Reported as “Total revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss)”. ³ Reported as “Net income (loss) per share attributable to common stockholders”.
Revenue growth of about 10% quarter-over-quarter and 12% year-to-date was driven by expansion in payment solutions and network solutions.
Payment solutions expanded materially following the AccessOne acquisition, lifting payment volume and financing activity.
Network solutions, including life sciences engagement, grew roughly 9–12% as patient outreach and program uptake deepened.
The company initiated a restructuring to eliminate about 220 roles, targeting meaningful run-rate cost savings.
Phreesia’s platform supported roughly 180M patient visits in FY2026, about one in six U.S. ambulatory visits, underpinning scale across offerings.
